notes: Oracle-side cross-check of docs/mc68010-boot-findings.md section 19. Confirms from the capture direction that the gsp_vram share is 4 MiB and not the 512 KiB both native/ models assume: 1664200 of 2097152 words nonzero at frame 600, over a contiguous 4194304-byte read from 0xff800000 with a pinned -nvram_directory.
